blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.
blocks.zh: 虽然VideoLLMs在理解短视频基准方面取得了显著进展,但它们往往难以总结长格式的基准。 这主要是由于长文提示引起的性能退化,保留时间连续性的固有困难,以及事件描述中缺乏精密丰富的概念. 为了解决这些问题,本文介绍了首个为视频处理而设计的递归视频语言总结模型(RVLSM),并针对长式视频到文本的总结. RVLSM递归地将视频分解成集成相通的片段并代表分块级推理到VideoLLM子模型和外部工具. 它采用(1)语义分解(STD),通过场景感知分解策略,按照语义边界动态地分出视频来保持时间的一致性和连续性;和(2)适应性多式工具调用(AMTC),通过有选择地引用动作识别、光学字符识别、自动语音识别和物体检测等辅助模块的路由机制,确保语义丰富的摘要。 在VideoXum和MixTyVSum基准上的实验显示,RVLSM在多个模型设置和性能度量度上持续改善于零镜头的VideoLLM基线,并具有先进精细的视频到文本汇总模型的竞争力. 重要的是,RVLSM摘要中被点名的实体与地面实况摘要中被测出的实体相比,与基线和最新方法被测出的实体更加一致,从而证实其生成的事件描述的显著性。

blocks.en:
Recent advances in VideoLLMs have significantly improved their understanding capabilities across different tasks, including video-to-text summarization. To create meaningful summaries of long-form videos,
models must identify and correlate key events and behaviors that occur over a
long period of time, which requires effectively capturing and
processing long-range temporal dependencies ( Li et al. 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
视频的最新进展 法学硕士课程大大提高了对不同任务的理解能力,包括视频到文本的总结。 为制作有意义的长相视频摘要,
模型必须识别并联系在以下情况下发生的关键事件和行为:
长期,这需要有效捕捉和
处理长距离时间依赖性(Li等2026.).

blocks.en: Despite recent improvements, the performance of VideoLLMs on long-form videos is challenged by the following issues:
blocks.zh: 尽管最近有所改进,但VideoLLMs在长相视频上的性能受到以下问题的挑战:

blocks.en: • Information compression : long videos are frequently compressed through sparse frame sampling, temporal pooling, or fixed-duration chunking, forcing models to reason over aggressively condensed visual representations ( Wang et al. 2025 ) . While often sufficient for short clips, these strategies become increasingly problematic for long-horizon and dense-event videos. • Context saturation : LLMs are prone to hallucination and performance drops when their context window is largely filled ( Zhang et al. 2024 ) . Since the position of multimodal information also matters, this is typically exacerbated by the lost-in-the-middle issue. • Temporal coherence degradation : on videos spanning multiple scenes, subjects, or actions, VideoLLMs struggle to preserve the temporal continuity of the event structure and the semantic saliency of event descriptions. Long-form video-to-text summarization thus requires reasoning over temporally distributed events while maintaining chronological consistency and exhaustive coverage of the underlying concepts ( Niu et al. 2025 ) . • Limited semantic richness of the event descriptions : summaries typically mention the key events occurring in the video, but the semantic concepts in the textual descriptions are not necessarily aligned with human expectations ( Cagliero et al. 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: • 信息压缩:长相的视频经常通过零散的帧取样、时间集合或固定的分块来压缩,迫使模型理智地过度收缩视觉表现(王等2025年)。 虽然这些策略往往足以提供短片,但对于长片和密集的视频来说,这些策略越来越成问题. • 背景饱和度: LLMs在上下文窗口基本被填充后容易发生幻觉和性能下降(Zhang等,2024年). 由于多式联运信息的地位也同样重要,因此通常会因中途失利而加剧。 · 时间一致性退化:在涉及多个场景、主题或行动的视频上,VideoLLMs为保持事件结构的时间连续性和事件描述的语义意义而挣扎。 因此,长式视频对文本的汇总需要推理,而不是时间分布的事件,同时保持时间顺序的一致性和基本概念的详尽覆盖(Niu等人,2025年) 事件描述的语义丰富度有限:摘要通常会提到视频中发生的关键事件,但文字描述中的语义概念不一定与人类的期望一致(Cagliero等人,2025年).

While often sufficient for short clips, these strategies become increasingly problematic for long-horizon and dense-event videos.

Long-form video-to-text summarization thus requires reasoning over temporally distributed events while maintaining chronological consistency and exhaustive coverage of the underlying concepts ( Niu et al. 2025 ) .

blocks.en:
To tackle the above issues, in this paper we present the first adaptation of the Recursive Language Models (RLMs) ( Zhang et al. 2026 ) towards long-form video-to-text summarization.
RLM is a recently proposed inference paradigm for textual LLMs,
where long textual context is treated as an external object inside persistent Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL) environments, allowing a root-LLM to
recursively invoke sub-VLLMs or external tools over portions of the input through programmatic decomposition.
Although they have proven to be effective in document summarization ( Zhang et al. 2026 ) , the existing framework is limited to the textual modality, overlooking the unique challenges of video-to-text summarization.
blocks.zh:
为了解决上述问题,我们在本文中介绍了 " 递归语言模型 " (RLMs)(张等2026年)的首次改编,走向长式视频对文本的总结。
RLM是最近提出的文本LLMs的推论范式,
将长文本上下文作为持久 Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL) 环境中的外部对象,允许根-LLM
通过程序分解在部分输入上连续引用子VLLM或外部工具.
虽然事实证明它们在文件归纳(张等2026年)中是有效的,但现有的框架仅限于文本模式,忽略了视频到文本归纳的独特挑战.

blocks.en:
We present Recursive Video Language Summarization Models ( RVLSMs ), a recursive framework for long-form video-to-text summarization that extends the RLM paradigm to multimodal video reasoning. Importantly, the proposed approach is agnostic to the pretrained LLM used. RVLSM treats the input video as an external multimodal object and recursively summarizes semantically coherent video segments through VideoLLM sub-calls and external tools (see Figure 1 ). Unlike static multimodal augmentation pipelines, RVLSM employs a heuristic routing mechanism to select the appropriate analysis configuration for each chunk based on previously generated summaries, enabling sequential context-aware evidence acquisition across the video timeline.
Specifically, RVLSM employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which chunks videos according to scene transitions and additional contextual features to preserve temporal coherence, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which calls auxiliary external tools for object detection, action recognition, automatic speech recognition and optical character recognition
through a programmable Root-LLM planner to ensure semantic richness of the summary.
blocks.zh:
我们提出递归式视频语言总结模型(RVLSMs),这是长式视频到文本总结的递归框架,将RLM范式扩展到多模式视频推理. 重要的是,拟议办法对预先训练的LLM所使用的方法不可知。 RVLSM通过VideoLLM子调用和外部工具,将输入视频作为外在多模式对象,并递归地总结出精准一致的视频段(见图一. 与静态多式增强管不同,RVLSM使用一种热度的路由机制,根据先前生成的概要,为每个块选择适当的分析配置,从而能够通过视频时间表相继获取上下文证据。
具体来说,RVLSM使用 (1)语义时空分解(STD),它根据场景过渡和额外的上下文特性来分解视频,以保持时间一致性;(2)适应性多式工具调用(AMTC),它调用辅助外部工具,用于物体检测,动作识别,自动语音识别和光学字符识别.
通过可编程的Root-LLM计划器,确保摘要的语义丰富.

blocks.en:
RVLSM addresses information compression and context saturation via the RLM paradigm, temporal coherence degradation using the STD component, and lack of semantic richness of the summary using the AMTC component.
Using RVLSM , we address the following Research Questions: RQ1) Is RLM beneficial for LLM-based video-to-text summarization of long-form videos compared to non-recursive zero-shot baselines? (see the results in Table 1 ). RQ2) What are the effects of the main RVLSMs ’s components? (see the ablation study in Figure 3 and Table 1 ). RQ3) Are the RVLSMs ’s summaries more closely aligned with human-generated ones in terms of presence of different NLP entities? (see the results in Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
RVLSM通过RLM范式处理信息压缩和上下文饱和,使用STD组件处理时间一致性退化,使用AMTC组件处理摘要缺乏语义丰富的问题.
使用RVLSM,我们处理以下研究问题: RQ1,RLM对基于LLM的视频到文本汇总长式视频相对于非反射零镜头基线是否有益?. (见表1的结果)。 问题2) RVLSM的主要部件有什么影响? (见图3和表1中的消化研究)。 问题3) 在NLP不同实体的存在方面,RVLSM的总结是否更贴近人类产生的总结? (见表2的结果)。

blocks.en: The main paper contributions are summarized below:
blocks.zh: 主要论文摘要如下:

blocks.en:
• We introduce the Recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM), a new recursive REPL-based framework for long-form video-to-text summarization agnostic to the pretrained LLMs used. • On two video benchmarks,
we demonstrate that the RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics , and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization (e.g., SBERT F1 on MixtyVSum: RVLSM 0.64 vs. Baseline non-recursive 0.57 vs. V2Xum Baseline 0.44). • We show RVLSM’s summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods (e.g., F1 MicroAverage on MixtyTVSum: RVLSM 0.14 vs. Baseline non-recursive 0.07 vs. V2Xum Baseline 0.03), confirming the saliency of the event descriptions the model produces.

我们证明,RVLSM在多个模型设置和性能衡量尺度上持续改进了零镜头VideoLLM基线,并具有对视频到文本汇总的先进微调模型的竞争力(例如,MixtyVSum上的SPERT F1:RVLSM 0.64 vs. Basin-Recursive 0.57 vs.V2Xum Basiness 0.44)。 我们显示RVLSM的概要与地面实况摘要中检测到的比较接近(例如,MixtyTVSum上的F1微量Average:RVLSM 0.14 vs. Basin 0.07 vs. V2Xum Basin 0.03),证实了模型生成的事件描述的显著性。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: Video-to-text Summarization
blocks.zh: 视频对文本摘要

blocks.en: Video-to-text summarization has traditionally focused on extractive methods that select key frames or representative clips from long videos ( Gong et al. 2014 ; Zhang et al. 2016 ; Lin et al. 2022 ) . More recent approaches have introduced reinforcement learning for learning compact video representations ( Zhou et al. 2018 ; Wang et al. 2024 ) . With the emergence of video LLMs, recent methods have shifted toward abstractive video-to-text summarization, directly generating natural language descriptions from visual and multimodal inputs ( Mu et al. 2024 ; Cagliero et al. 2025 ; Lee et al. 2025 ; Hua et al. 2025 ) . Despite strong performance on short videos, current VideoLLMs remain constrained by limited temporal context windows and typically rely on sparse frame sampling or fixed temporal compression strategies.
blocks.zh: 视频对文本的总结传统上侧重于从长视频中选择关键帧或代表性剪辑的取取取方法(Gong等. 2014; 张等. 2016; Lin等2022 (中文(简体) ). 更近一些的方法引入了强化学习,用于学习紧凑的视频展示(周等. 2018; 王等2024 (中文(简体) ). 随着视频LLMS的出现,最近的方法已转向抽象的视频到文本的总结,直接从视觉和多模式输入中产生自然语言描述(Mu等)。 2024; 卡格列罗等. 2025; Lee等编. 2025; Hua等2025 (中文(简体) ). 尽管在短视频上表现很出色,但目前的视频 LLMs仍然受到有限时间上下文窗口的制约,通常依赖于有限的帧采样或固定的时间压缩策略.

blocks.en: Long-form Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 长式视频理解

blocks.en:
Recent work has studied how to extend VideoLLMs capabilities to longer temporal horizons
through memory modules, hierarchical architectures, sparse attention mechanisms,
or temporal compression strategies ( Wu et al. 2024 ; Song et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2026 ) . Hierarchical summarization pipelines commonly split long videos into fixed-duration segments before independently summarizing each chunk ( Pennec et al. 2026 ) .
Although effective in reducing memory usage, fixed chunking may fragment semantically
coherent events across temporal boundaries. RVLSM, instead, performs scene-aware
temporal decomposition through dynamic scene-based chunking, enabling recursive
reasoning over semantically coherent video segments.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作研究了如何将VideoLLMs的能力扩展到较长的时间范围
通过内存模块,层次结构, 稀少的注意力机制,
或时间压缩策略(Wu等. 2024; 宋等编. 2024; 王等 2026 (中文(简体) ). 分级汇总管道通常先将长相视频分解为固定时间段,然后再独立归纳出每个块(Pennec等人,2026年)。
虽然在减少内存使用方面很有效,但固定的块块可能从整体上分解
跨越时间界限的一致事件。 反之,RVLSM进行场景感知
通过动态场景分解进行时间分解,实现递归
(b) 推理而不是模拟一致的视频部分。

blocks.zh: 目前工作的立场

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first attempt to apply RLMs to long-context inputs in the video modality, targeting video-to-text summarization because its programmatic and recursive nature can overcome the aforementioned limitations.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这是第一次尝试将RLM应用于视频模式中的长文本输入,目标是视频到文本的汇总,因为其程序性和递归性能够克服上述局限性。

blocks.zh: 递归视频语言总结模型

blocks.en:
Algorithm 1 describes the overall execution process. Given a video V V ,
RVLSM initializes a REPL environment containing the input video together with functions
for scene-aware chunking, recursive VideoLLM querying, and multimodal tool execution.
The Root-LLM iteratively dispatches sub-calls to VideoLLM sub-models, collecting chunk-level summaries, and finally aggregates them into a single coherent abstractive summary.

Root-LLM迭代地向VideoLLM子模型发送子调用,收集块级摘要,并最后将它们汇总为单一的连贯抽象摘要.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Recursive Video Language Summarization Model
blocks.zh: 算法 1 递归视频语言总结模型

blocks.en: RVLSM introduces two key modifications tailored to long-video understanding: scene-aware Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD) and Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC).
blocks.zh: RVLSM引入了两个针对长视理解的关键修改:场景感知语义分解(STD)和可适应多式工具调用(AMTC).

blocks.en: Semantic Temporal Decomposition
blocks.zh: 语义分解

blocks.en:
Unlike standard fixed-duration chunking, the STD module performs an adaptive scene-based segmentation of the video.

blocks.en: REPL Environment and Recursive Video Queries
blocks.zh: REPL 环境和递归视频查询

blocks.en: RVLSM operates inside a persistent Python REPL environment containing the input video and a collection of executable functions. The environment exposes functions for retrieving video metadata, performing scene-aware semantic temporal decomposition, querying VideoLLMs, and extracting multimodal signals from video chunks. The Root-LLM interacts with the environment iteratively by generating executable Python code. Intermediate summaries and tool outputs are stored as variables inside the REPL, allowing subsequent recursive calls to access previously computed information.
blocks.zh: RVLSM在一个持久的Python REPL环境中运行,包含输入视频和可执行功能集合. 环境暴露了检索视频元数据、进行场景感知语义时间分解、查询视频LLMs和从视频块中提取多模式信号的功能。 Root-LLM通过生成可执行的Python代码来与环境进行迭代交互. 中期摘要和工具产出作为变量储存在REPL内,以便随后的再接再励地调用以前计算的信息。

through external tools. Experiments focus on a single recursive level in which the Root-LLM delegates chunk-level summarization to VideoLLM sub-calls. The framework generalizes to deeper recursive hierarchies over temporal sub-events.

blocks.en: Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling
blocks.zh: 适应性多式联运 工具调用

blocks.en:
To complement recursive calls to VideoLLMs, RVLSM augments chunk-level analysis through external tools specialized for video understanding.
The REPL environment provides access to auxiliary multimodal analysis functions that extract semantic signals from each video chunk.
blocks.zh:
为补充对VideoLLMs的递归性呼叫,RVLSM通过专门用于视频理解的外部工具来增强块级分析.
REPL环境提供辅助多模式分析功能,从每个视频块中提取语义信号.

blocks.en: Specifically, RVLSM can invoke object detection, action recognition, automatic speech recognition (ASR), and Optical Character Recognition (OCR). The extracted knowledge is injected into the VideoLLM sub-model prompt alongside the video chunk, providing structured perceptual grounding that enhances the quality of the generated chunk-level summary.
blocks.zh: 具体而言,RVLSM可以引用对象检测,动作识别,自动语音识别(ASR),和光学字符识别(OCR). 所提取的知识与视频块一并注入VideoLLM子模型,提供结构化的感知地平面,提高生成的块级摘要的质量。

blocks.en: Algorithm 2 AdaptiveToolSelector
blocks.zh: 算法 2 适应工具选择器

blocks.en: Unlike static multimodal augmentation pipelines, RVLSM performs heuristic adaptive tool selection. The first chunk is analyzed using full multimodal extraction in order to establish an initial semantic context. For subsequent chunks the Root-LLM selects the appropriate analysis configuration based on the previous chunk summary:
blocks.zh: 与静态多模式增强管不同,RVLSM执行热力适应工具选择. 第一个块是利用完全的多式取出来分析的,以便建立初始语义上下文. 对于后续块,根-LLM根据上一个块摘要选择适当的分析配置 :

blocks.en: r i = ℛ ⁡ ( s i − 1 ) , r_{i}=\mathcal{R}(s_{i-1}),
blocks.zh: r i = r ⁡ (s i − 1 ), r i }=\ mathcal{R} (s_{i 1}),

blocks.en: where ℛ \mathcal{R} denotes the routing mechanism.
blocks.zh: R\ mathcal{R} 表示路径机制。

blocks.en:
The procedure described in Algorithm 2 focuses on the AdaptiveToolSelector . Each perceptual signal is associated with one of four categories (actions, speech,text, and objects) corresponding respectively to action recognition, automatic speech recognition, optical character recognition, and object detection. Every category is paired with a predefined set of representative keywords (its root set), against which the previous chunk summary s i − 1 s_{i-1} is matched. A normalized keyword-matching score is then computed for each category by dividing the raw number of matches by the size of the corresponding keyword set, so that categories with larger keyword sets are not favored.
The selector defaults to VideoQuery when no signal is detected, to EnrichedVideoQuery when no category dominates, and to the corresponding SingleModalityQuery otherwise.
blocks.zh:
算法2所描述的程序侧重于适应工具选择器。 每个知觉信号都与四个类别(动作,语音,文本,和物体)中的一个相关,分别对应动作识别,自动语音识别,光学字符识别,和物体检测. 每个类别都配有一套预先确定的代表性关键词(其根集),与之相配的是先前的块摘要 s − 1 s_{i-1 }. 然后通过将匹配的生数除以相应的关键词集的大小来计算每个类的普通关键词匹配分数,这样就不会偏好带有较大关键词集的类.
选择器默认在未检测到信号时会进行视频查询,在无类别支配时会进行丰富视频查询,另外也会进行相应的SingleModity查询.

blocks.en: We evaluate RVLSM on two long video-to-text summarization benchmarks: VideoXum ( Lin et al. 2024 ) and MixTyVSum ( Cagliero et al. 2025 ) . VideoXum focuses on holistic narrative summarization of open-domain videos, while MixTyVSum emphasizes dense event-centric summarization with temporal and spatial annotations. Following our long-video setting, we restrict VideoXum to videos longer than 230 seconds and we removed MSVD ( Hendria 2025 ) videos from MixTyVSum, because they are all shorter than 20 seconds. Additional details are provided in the Supplementary Document.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个长视频对文本的总结基准来评价RVLSM:VideoXum(Lin等2024年)和MixTyVSum(Cagliero等2025年). 视频 Xum专注于开放域视频的整体叙事概括,而MixTyVSum则以时间和空间说明来强调密集的事件-以事件为中心的概括. 在长视频设定之后,我们把VideoXum限制在超过230秒的视频上,并删除了MixTyVSum的MSVD(Hendria 2025)视频,因为这些视频都短于20秒. 补充文件提供了更多详情。

blocks.en:
We compare the generated summaries with the ground truth using the F1-Score values of the following established metrics: ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L ( Lin 2004 ) and SBERT ( Reimers and Gurevych 2019 ) , computed as the cosine similarity between the Sentence-BERT embeddings of the generated and reference summaries. We further report METEOR ( Banerjee and Lavie 2005 ) , BLEU-4 ( Papineni et al. 2002 ) , and CIDEr ( Oliveira dos Santos et al. 2021 ) , three metrics commonly adopted for video captioning and summarization evaluation.
For the Named Entity Recognition analysis, we report Precision, Recall, and F1 score. More details in the Supplementary Document.
Aggregated values are computed as the micro-average over TP, FP, and FN across entity types.
blocks.zh:
我们使用下列既定指标的F1-分数值将生成的概要与地面真理进行比较:ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2、ROUGE-L(林 2004)和SPERT(里默斯和Gurevich 2019),这些数值作为生成概要和参考概要的句子-BERT嵌入的同声相近性计算。 我们还报告METEOR(Banerjee和Lavie,2005年),BLEU-4(Papineni等人,2002年)和CIDER(Oliveira dos Santos等人,2021年),这三种标准通常用于视频字幕和总结评价。
关于命名实体识别分析,我们报告精度、回想和F1分数。 更多详情见补充文件。
综合值作为跨实体类型TP、FP和FN的微观平均值来计算。

blocks.en:
Following the RLM paradigm ( Zhang et al. 2026 ) , our pipeline distinguishes between two types of models. The Root-LLM is a coding-oriented LLM acting as the main orchestrator: it decomposes the input,
manages intermediate variables, and dispatches sub-calls within the REPL
environment. The sub-LLM is, in our context, a multimodal Video LLM invoked recursively
by the root-LLM to process individual video segments and return structured descriptions.
We experimented with two root-LLMs (GPT-5.4 ( Singh et al. 2026 ) and
Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B ( Qwen Team 2025 ) ) and four sub-LLMs (Molmo2-8B ( Clark et al. 2026 ) , Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-Instruct ( Bai et al. 2025 ) , and Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Xu et al. 2025 ) ).
Further details are given in the Supplementary Document.
blocks.zh:
遵循RLM范式(张等2026年),我们的管线区分出两种型号. Root-LLM是一个以编码为导向的LLM作为主要管弦乐器:它分解了输入,
管理中间变量,并在REPL内发送子调用
环境。 在我们的语境中,LLM子是一个重复引用的多式视频LLM
由 root-LLM 处理单个视频段并返回结构化描述。
我们试验了两种根-LLM(GPT-5.4(Singh等人,2026年))和
Quen3-编码器 480B-A35B (Quen Team 2025.))和4个子LLMs(Molmo2-8B (Clark等2026.), Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qune/Qune3-VL-30B-Instruct (Bai等2025.), 和 Qune/Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct (Xu等2025.)).
进一步详情见补充文件。

blocks.en:
For Named Entity Recognition we use SpaCy ( Honnibal et al. 2020 ) ( en_core_web_sm model).
For scene-aware STD we use PySceneDetect ( Castellano 2014 ) .
Object-level semantic signals are extracted using YOLOv8 ( Jocher and Qiu 2023 ) pretrained on the COCO dataset, applied every 10 frames.
Action-level semantic evidence is obtained through MMAction2 ( MMAction2 Contributors 2020 ) using a TSN model (ResNet-50, Kinetics-400), retaining only predictions above a confidence threshold of 0.80 0.80 .
Automatic speech recognition is extracted using Whisper ( Radford et al. 2022 ) ( medium variant), and optical character recognition is detected using EasyOCR ( AI 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
对于命名的实体识别,我们使用SpaCy(Honnibal等2020年)(en_core_web_sm模型).
使用PyScene Detection(Castellano 2014),
对象级语义信号使用YOLOv8(Jocher和Quu 2023)在COCO数据集上预训取出,每10帧应用.
通过MMAction2(MMAction2 controductioners 2020)使用TMN模型(ResNet-50,Kinetics-400),通过MMAction2(MMAction2 controductioners 2020)获得动作语义学证据,仅保留超过0.800.80的置信阈值的预测.
使用Whisper(拉德福德等2022年)(中变种)提取出自动语音识别,使用EasyOCR(AI 2020)检测出光学字符识别.

blocks.en: Main Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 主要结果和讨论

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports the main summarization results on MixTyVSum and VideoXum across the different sub-VLLM settings.
Recursive video-to-text summarization outperforms the monolithic zero-shot baselines, demonstrating the benefit of STD for long videos. In fact, on MixTyVSum, the strongest performance is obtained by RVLSM with STD paired with Qwen3-Omni-30B, which achieves the highest ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores; on VideoXum, RVLSM with Qwen3-VL-30B yields the best results overall, attaining both the highest ROUGE scores and the highest SBERT similarity. METEOR follows the same ordering as ROUGE across both benchmarks, corroborating this ranking.
blocks.zh:
表1报告不同子VLLM设置的MixTyVSum和VideoXum的主要汇总结果.
递回式视频到文本的汇总比单片零镜头基线要好,显示了STD对长视频的好处. 事实上,在MixTyVSum上,最强的性能由RVLSM获得,STD与Qune3-Omni-30B对齐,后者实现了最高的ROUGE-1,ROUGE-2和ROUGE-L分数;在VideoXum上,由Qune3-VL-30B获得的RVLSM总体效果最好,既达到了最高的ROUGE分数,也达到了最高的SBERT相近. METEOR遵循与ROUGE相同的命令,贯穿两个基准,证实了这一排名.

blocks.en: The comparison with the fine-tuned V2Xum-LLaMA-7B ( Hua et al. 2025 ) is informative for assessing generalization. On VideoXum, on which it was optimized, the fine-tuned model retains an advantage on surface-overlap metrics, yet the best zero-shot RVLSM configuration still surpasses it on ROUGE-1, METEOR, and, most notably, on SBERT similarity (0.6380 vs. 0.5573), indicating that recursive summarization captures the semantics of the reference summaries even without task-specific training. On MixTyVSum the picture reverses: the fine-tuned model falls below the zero-shot sub-VLLMs on nearly all metrics, whereas RVLSM improves over both baselines by a wide margin. This suggests that a model tuned to a single summarization distribution transfers poorly across benchmarks, while the recursive approach generalizes robustly.
blocks.zh: 与经过微调的V2Xum-LLaMA-7B(Hua等人,2025年)的比较为评估概括性提供了信息。 在被优化的VideoXum上,微调模型保留了表面重叠度量衡的优势,然而最佳的零镜头RVLSM配置在ROUGE-1,METEOR上仍然超过它,最出名的是SBERT相似性(0.6380 vs. 0.5573)上,表明回溯性归纳即使在没有任务特定训练的情况下也能捕捉出参考摘要的语义. 在MixTyVSum上,图片反相:微调模型在几乎所有度量衡上都低于零发子VLLM,而RVLSM则在两个基线上都有了很大的改进. 这表明,一种模式的取向是单一的汇总分配,但跨基准的转移不佳,而递归式办法则十分普遍。

blocks.en: The choice of Root-LLM markedly affects recursive summarization quality. Figure 2 shows, for each combination of sub-VLLM and metric, the differences in performance scores between using GPT-5.4 and Qwen-480B as Root-LLM, under both fixed-duration (w/o STD) and scene-aware (w/ STD) decomposition. Results show that the peformance is roughly comparable, underscoring the practical advantages of using opensource tools.
blocks.zh: Root-LLM的选择明显地影响了递归性总结的质量. 图2显示,在固定期限(w/o STD)和场景感知(w/STD)分解下,每组合次VLLM和度量计,使用GPT-5.4和Quen-480B作为根-LLM的性能分分数的差异. 结果显示,该变相大致具有可比性,强调了使用开源工具的实际优势.

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance comparison between RVLSM (ours), the traditional (non-recursive) VideoLLM baselines, and the recently proposed V2Xum model ( Hua et al. 2025 ) fine-tuned on VideoXum. The RVLSM block reports the recursive pipeline with scene-aware STD, and its combination with multimodal tool calling (STD+MTC) and adaptive multimodal tool calling (STD+AMTC), across two representative Sub-VLLMs.
blocks.zh: 表1:对RVLSM(我们),传统(非重复)VideoLLM基线,以及最近提出的V2Xum模型(Hua等2025)在VideoXum上的性能比较. RVLSM块报告带有场景感知性传染疾病(STD+MTC)的递归管线,以及它与多模式工具调用(STD+MTC)和可适应多模式工具调用(STD+AMTC)的结合,跨越两个有代表性的分VLLMs.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Proprietary and open-source Root-LLM: performance gap between GPT-5.4 and Qwen-480B across datasets and settings (w/ and w/o STD).
blocks.zh: 图 2: 专有和开源 Root-LLM:在数据集和设置(w/和w/o STD)中GPT-5.4和Quen-480B之间的性能差距.

blocks.en: Figure 3: SBERT comparison on MixTyVSum and VideoXum (a) and across the MixTyVSum subsets (b).
blocks.zh: 图3:SPERT对MixTyVSum和VideoXum的比较(a)并跨MixTyVSum子集(b).

blocks.en: We examine the role of Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC) by comparing three scenarios: RVLSM+STD, which employs scene-aware decomposition without multimodal tool integration; RVLSM+MTC, which uses multimodal tools but not adaptively; and RVLSM+AMTC, which employs multimodal tools adaptively. Table 1 reports the performance of the two sub-VLLMs under these strategies, and Figure 3(a) summarizes the corresponding SBERT behavior on the two benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较三种情况来审查适应性多式联运工具调用的作用:RVLSM+STD,它采用场景感知分解而不采用多式联运工具集成;RVLSM+MTC,它使用多式联运工具但不采用适应性;RVLSM+AMTC,它采用适应性多式联运工具。 表1报告了这些战略下两个次级VLLMs的性能,图3(a)概述了这两个基准上相应的SPERT行为.

blocks.en:
A clear divergence arises between the benchmarks due to differing annotation styles. On MixTyVSum, which features action-oriented and semantically dense summaries, adaptive injection enhances semantic quality (SBERT and METEOR).
However, this can lead to a decline in ROUGE scores, particularly for Qwen3-Omni-30B, which performs best with STD alone, indicating a trade-off between semantic detail and lexical overlap. Conversely, on VideoXum, where summaries are more generic, injection is largely ineffective, with RVLSM+STD achieving the best scores across most metrics for both sub-VLLMs.
blocks.zh:
由于说明风格不同,基准之间有明显的差异。 在MixTyVSum上,它具有面向行动和密集的集成摘要,适应性地注射可以提高语义质量(SBERT和METEOR)。
然而,这可能导致ROUGE分数下降,特别是Qune3-Omni-30B,单是性病表现最好,表明语义细节与语法重叠之间的取舍. 反之,在"VideoXum"上,摘要比较通俗,注射基本无效,RVLSM+STD在两个子VLLMs的多数公分中都取得了最佳分数.

blocks.en: Additionally, Figure 3(b) decomposes SBERT by source dataset and shows that the benefit of injection depends on how well STD alone already captures the video content. On structured, procedural subsets such as EpicKitchens and SumMe, STD is already strong and injection yields no gain or a marginal drop; on more diverse subsets such as TVSum and ActivityNet, adaptive injection provides substantial improvements (TVSum: STD=0.551 to AMTC=0.701; ActivityNet: STD=0.575 to AMTC=0.655). Across all four subsets, RVLSM+AMTC consistently outperforms RVLSM+MTC, and its advantage is largest precisely in the structured domains where indiscriminate injection is most harmful (EpicKitchens: MTC=0.577 to AMTC=0.600; SumMe: MTC=0.577 to AMTC=0.611). This confirms the benefit of adaptive tool selection over unconditional invocation: applying every multimodal analysis regardless of context introduces noise that offsets, and in structured domains, outweighs the benefit of the injected signal.
blocks.zh: 此外,图3(b)按源数据集对SPERT进行分解,并显示注射的好处取决于STD本身已经捕捉到视频内容的程度。 在结构化的、程序性的子集如EpicKitchens和SumMe中,STD已经很强了,注射不会产生收益或微量下降;在TVSum和ActiveNet中,适应性注射提供了实质性改进(TVSum:STD=0.551到AMTC=0.701;ActiveNet:STD=0.575到AMTC=0.655)。 在所有四个子集中,RVLSM+AMTC的性能始终超过RVLSM+MTC,其优势恰恰在滥注射最有害的结构化领域最大(EpicKitchens:MTC=0.577至AMTC=0.600;SumMe:MTC=0.577至AMTC=0.611)。 这证实了因地制宜地选择工具而不是无条件援引的好处:不论背景如何,采用每一种多式联运分析都会产生噪声,在结构化领域,噪声会抵消注入信号的好处。

blocks.en:
We empirically verify whether the RVLSM ’s summaries are more closely aligned with human expectations
than baseline methods in terms of NLP entities retrieved in the ground-truth summary.
The core idea is to verify the semantic alignment in terms of matching with semantically rich concepts.
Table 2 reports the Precision, Recall, and F1 MicroAverages separately for each entity type.
blocks.zh:
我们实证地核实RVLSM的总结是否更符合人类的期望
在地面实况摘要中检索的NLP实体的基准方法。
核心思想是从与精致丰富的概念相匹配的角度来验证语义上的一致性.
表2报告精度、召回和F1微分 每个实体类型的平均数分别列出。

blocks.en: On MixTyVSum, RVLSM attains the best aggregate scores (F1=0.170 to 0.081 for the VideoLLM baseline) and leads on most entity types, including work_of_art , date , and person , where the baselines recover no entity. Overall, RVLSM recovers salient entities that surface-overlap metrics tend to overlook. We also evaluate extracted named entities on V2Xum-generated summaries. However, only a few cardinal are detected, leading to all zeros matric values for all other entities. More results are reported in the Supplementary Document.
blocks.zh: 在MixTyVSum上,RVLSM获得最好的总分(VideoLLM基线为F1=0.170至0.081),并领先于大多数实体类型,包括工程_of_art,日期和人物,基线没有恢复任何实体. 总体而言,RVLSM恢复了表面重叠度量衡往往忽略的突出实体. 我们还在由V2Xum生成的摘要中评价取出的名称实体。 然而,仅检测出少数红外线,导致所有其他实体的母性值为零。 补充文件报告了更多的结果。

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-Judge
blocks.zh: LLM 现职法官

blocks.en:
To complement automatic metrics, an LLM-as-a-Judge A/B test ( Zheng et al. 2023 ) is conducted using Gemini 3.1 Pro ( gemini-3.1-pro-preview ) across all three configurations Qwen3-VL-30B compared with the baseline. Results in Table 3 confirm the trends
observed through automatic metrics, with the use of STD and the AMTC achieving the best overall performance.

blocks.en: Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 5: A qualitative example from MixTyVSum showing the summaries generated by RVLSM w/ STD + AMTC, compared to the zero-shot baseline and the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 图5:MixTyVSum的一个定性实例,显示与零镜头基线和地面真相相比,RVLSM w/STD + AMTC生成的摘要.

blocks.en: This section presents two representative examples highlighting scenarios in which the RVLSM approach shows clear advantages over the baseline. Figure 4 reports the result generated from a sample video of the VideoXum dataset, where the RVLSM summary exploits OCR injection to accurately identify the on-screen information and the ASR transcript to detail the specific technique demonstrated. In contrast, the baseline produces a generic description that mentions neither the instructor’s identity nor the specific content, confirming that without recursive decomposition relevant information dispersed over time tends to be lost. A second case is shown in Figure 5 , a summary generated from EpicKitchens as part of the MixTyVSum annotations. Here the baseline captures only a subset of ingredients and omits secondary activities such as dishwashing and table setting, whereas the RVLSM, leveraging its recursive structure, reconstructs the full sequence of events in close alignment with the ground truth. This example illustrates how the framework scales with video duration, yielding greater improvements as content becomes longer and more complex.
blocks.zh: 本节举出两个有代表性的例子,着重说明RVLSM方法明显优于基准的情景。 图4报告了VideoXum数据集样本视频产生的结果,其中RVLSM摘要利用OCR注射来准确识别屏幕上的信息和ASR记录片来详细说明所展示的具体技术. 与此相反,基准产生的一般说明既未提及教员的身份也未提及具体内容,确认如果没有递归分解,则往往会丢失随时间推移而分散的相关信息。 第二个案例如图5所示,这是EpicKitchens作为MixTyVSum说明的一部分产生的摘要. 在此,基线只捕捉到一组成分,并省略了诸如洗碗和桌子设置等次要活动,而RVLSM则利用其递归结构,按照地表真理来重建全部事件的顺序. 这个例子说明框架如何以视频持续时间衡量,随着内容的延长和复杂程度的提高,产生了更大的改进。

blocks.en: Statistical Significance Tests
blocks.zh: 统计意义测试

blocks.en: To rank the summarizers on each benchmark, we apply the Borda Count re-ranking strategy ( van Erp and Schomaker 2000 ) , a group consensus function that merges the per-video rankings (231 for VideoXum, 60 for MixTyVSum) into a single one by assigning decreasing integer scores to each ranking and summing them. The RVLSM approaches w/ STD dominate on both benchmarks: on MixTyVSum, Qwen3-Omni-30B and Qwen3-VL-30B rank first and second (242 and 221) ahead of the best w/o STD model (205), and Qwen3-VL-30B leads on VideoXum.
blocks.zh: 为了对每个基准的总结者进行排序,我们采用Borda Counter重排策略(van Erp和Schomaker 2000 ),这个群体共识功能将每个视频的排名(231为VideoXum,60为MixTyVSum)合并为一个单一的,通过给每个排名分配递减的整数分数来进行组合. RVLSM在两个基准上都以w/STD为主:在MixTyVSum上,Qune3-Omni-30B和Qune3-VL-30B排名第一和第二(242和221)位居最佳w/o STD模式(205)前;在VideoXum上,Qune3-VL-30B领先.

blocks.en: Conclusions and future work
blocks.zh: 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We introduced the recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM), which extends the RLM paradigm to long-video abstractive summarization through Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD) and Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC). Across multiple VideoLLMs and benchmarks, RVLSM yields consistent improvements that grow with video duration, while our ablation shows that the value of knowledge injection depends on the informativeness of the visual signal, motivating adaptive rather than indiscriminate augmentation. Future work will explore deeper recursion, aggregating summaries over multiple hierarchical levels, and Deep Reinforcement Learning to mitigate specific limitations of the RLM approach.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了递归视频语言总结模型(RVLSM),通过语义分解(STD)和适应多式工具调用(AMTC)将RLM范式扩展到了长视频抽象归纳. 纵观多个视频LM和基准,RVLSM产生连续不断的改进,随着视频持续时间的延长而增加,而我们的淡化表明,知识注入的价值取决于视觉信号的信息性,激发适应性而不是不加区分地增强。 今后的工作将探索更深层次的重复,汇总多个层次的总结,并深入强化学习,以缓解RLM方法的具体局限性。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Despite promising results, our approach has several limitations that point to directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 尽管我们的做法取得了有希望的结果,但有一些局限性,为今后的工作指明了方向。

blocks.en: The current routing relies on heuristic keyword matching; more principled alternatives, such as learned or reinforcement-learning-based routing optimized for summarization quality, are a promising direction.
blocks.zh: 目前的路由依赖于热度关键词匹配;更具原则性的替代方法,如为归纳质量而优化的有知识或以强化学习为基础的路由,是一个很有希望的方向.

blocks.en: The benefits of RVLSM would likely be more pronounced on longer videos, yet benchmarks with very long videos and high-quality reference summaries remain scarce due to the annotation effort required.
blocks.zh: RVLSM的好处在较长的视频中可能更为明显,然而由于需要做出说明,带有非常长的视频和高质量的参考摘要的基准仍然很少。

blocks.en: Visual scene detection may yield semantically incoherent segments when transitions are subtle, as in egocentric videos; multimodal boundary detection combining visual, audio, and action signals could mitigate this.
blocks.zh: 视觉场景探测在过渡微妙时,如以自我为中心的视频中,可能会产生不连贯的片段;结合视觉、音频和行动信号的多模式边界探测可以减轻这种情况。

blocks.en: Evaluation depends on the annotation style of the reference summaries: generic and event-driven ones respond very differently to knowledge injection, suggesting that standard metrics may not assess model quality in an annotation-agnostic way.
blocks.zh: 评价取决于参考摘要的注释风格:通用和事件驱动的注释对知识注入的反应非常不同,说明标准衡量标准可能不会以注释-不可知的方式评估模型质量.

blocks.en: Ethics, risks, and Generative AI Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守、风险和遗传性AI声明

blocks.en: The video data and annotations used in this work were obtained from third-party sources and do not introduce ethical concerns, such as unethical or offensive content, related to the input data. Due to the non-deterministic nature of the generative process, we cannot ensure that the summarized outputs are free of hallucination. However, the output summaries have been reviewed by at least two PhD-level researchers prior to the final evaluation. Generative AI was used as a research engine and its outputs were carefully reviewed by the authors; minor AI support also includes writing suggestions such as grammar corrections. The project code is publicly available under the CC BY-NC license. Part of the project builds upon the original RLM architecture ( Zhang et al. 2026 ) ; credits to the owner, changes, and specific settings are reported in the code repository.
blocks.zh: 这项工作中使用的视频数据和说明来自第三方来源,没有引入与输入数据有关的道德问题,如不道德或攻击性内容。 由于基因过程的非决定性性质,我们无法确保汇总的产出没有幻觉. 然而,在最后评价之前,至少有两名博士级研究人员审查了产出摘要。 基因AI被用作研究引擎,其产出被作者仔细审查;小AI支持还包括文法修正等写作建议. 项目代码以CC BY-NC许可证公开. 部分项目以原RLM架构(张等2026年)为主;在代码寄存器中上报给所有者的信用,变更,以及具体设置.
